a) Ropes with low internal stresses - Ropes which are manufactured using methods aimed at stresses arising from spinning. These methods can include preforming and postforming. b) Ropes with low torsional stresses - Ropes in which the wires and layers bf manner that, when under tension due to a free axial load, the rope will have a degree of rotation.
